Customer data must not go to AI tools we have not approved. Use Contoso Assistant instead: it keeps prompts in our tenant & retains nothing outside it. Paste the same request there, or ask the security team in #ai-help if it cannot help. See “Approved AI tools” at the link below.
https://intranet.example/ai/approved-tools?from=hook&rule=redirect_customer_data
